assessment.reason: The model has a large edge over the price, but Edmonton's listed defensive absences could raise Shea's minutes or special-teams role beyond the 20.3-minute projection. That one deployment fact could shift a low-volume under case.
assessment.model_case: The model projects about 0.8 shots against a 1.5 line, so it needs at least two shots to lose. The weakness is that the projection depends on a stable role, and the sensitivity test only scales means by a tenth. It does not test a promotion to a top pair or the power play.
assessment.price_case: At -160 on the main line, break-even is about -160 against a model fair price near -407. The two other books' consensus sits near the offered price. A gap this wide may reflect market pricing of an expanded role rather than an error.
assessment.context_case: The injury listing suggests Edmonton's defence is thinned, which could plausibly lift Shea's usage. Whether the model features already reflect that is unknown. The goalie projection is also unsettled, with Tarasov listed day-to-day.
blocking_checks: Confirm Shea's pairing and power-play assignment with Ekholm listed out. Top-pair or PP1 minutes would raise his shot volume beyond the modeled 20.3 minutes and narrow the under's edge.

qualitative_review.countercase: The market may price Shea as taking on Ekholm's minutes, including power-play shifts. In that case two shots becomes far more reachable than the model's low mean implies. A trailing Oilers game script could also push more point shots from the blue line.
open_checks: Morning skate or line rushes for Edmonton defence pairs
Detroit starting goalie given Tarasov's day-to-day listing
Reconfirm -160 is still available before puck drop

evidence.interpretation: If Ekholm misses this game, Shea may absorb more ice time or special-teams usage. That would raise his shot expectation above the model's projection.

assessment.reason: The under has a thin margin. The projected mean sits just below 1.5, while three other books lean toward the over. Unverified power-play or top-pair usage is the deployment fact most likely to erase the edge before the 8:40 PM EDT puck drop.
assessment.model_case: Projected mean is about 1.46 shots against a 1.5 line, with a median of one. The case rests on 19.9 projected minutes and a shrunk shot rate. Scaled sensitivity stays above break-even, but the mean is so close to the line that a modest role or rate increase flips it.
assessment.price_case: Even money on the main 1.5 line requires a break-even of one-half. The model's fair price is near -137, with a stated minimum of about -109. Three other books price this as roughly a coin flip. A 0.1-weight blend leaves near-zero value, so the gap reflects the model's choice of rate against the market's.
assessment.context_case: Context is unverified. Nemec does not appear in the injury excerpt, which does not establish that he is healthy or active. Toronto's listed defensive absences and Calgary's day-to-day center could shift possession and deployment in either direction. No line or power-play reporting is available.
blocking_checks: Nemec's power-play unit and pairing: a top-unit role or 20+ minutes would push expected shots above 1.5 and undercut the under.

qualitative_review.countercase: The market's lean toward the over may already reflect power-play usage or shot volume that the shrunk rate understates. If Toronto's depleted defense lets Calgary control play, a defenseman's shot attempts could rise. The model's mean sits within a fraction of a shot of the line, so small errors in the rate or ice time decide the bet. The goalie projection matters little for shot counts.
open_checks: Confirm Nemec's team assignment and active status from official lineups.
Check projected lines and power-play units from morning skate reporting.
Verify Bovada's settlement rules for overtime and participation.
Reconfirm the +100 price is still available.

evidence.interpretation: If Toronto's defense is depleted, Calgary may hold more possession. That could raise opposing shot volume and work against an under. The listing is a snapshot of uncertain timing.

evidence.interpretation: If Backlund sits, Calgary's forward and power-play units could be reshuffled. The effect on Nemec's usage is unknown in either direction.
